name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.6 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 6 visits over 31 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 33 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 31 hours starting 2025-08-04, at wavelengths from 1.21 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
